key_name.description: The name of the existing SSH key pair to be used for secure access to the virtual machine. For additional information on SSH key pairs, [**click here**](https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/api-reference/core-resources/keypairs/).

user_data.description: Optional initialization configuration commands to manage the configuration of a virtual machine at launch using cloud-init scripts. For more information about custom VM configuration using cloud-init, [**click here**](https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/virtual-machines/initialization-configuration).

callback_url.description: An optional URL where actions performed on the virtual machine will be sent. For additional information on event callbacks, [**click here**](https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/api-reference/core-resources/virtual-machines/callbacks-vms/).

assign_floating_ip.description: When this field is set to `true`, it attaches a [public IP address](https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/api-reference/core-resources/virtual-machines/floating-ip/) to the virtual machine, enabling internet accessibility.

enable_port_randomization.description: Indicates whether to enable port randomization.This setting is only effective if 'assign_floating_ip' is true. Defaults to true.

count.description: The number of virtual machines to be created.

enhanced_monitoring_enabled.description: When true, the Hyperstack VM Agent is opted in for this VM and metrics ingestion is allowed by the prom-gateway. The agent must still be installed on the VM (typically via user_data cloud-init).

name.description: The name of the key pair that is being created.

environment_name.description: The name of the environment where the key pair is being created.

public_key.description: The public key that is being used to import an SSH key pair.

name.description: The new name for the organition

enabled.description: Set to true to opt this VM into Enhanced Metrics, false to opt out.

firewall_ids.description: IDs of the firewalls to apply to all nodes in this node group

install_command.description: One-liner the user can run inside the VM to install the agent when enabling. Omitted when disabling.

direction.description: The direction of traffic that the firewall rule applies to.

protocol.description: The network protocol associated with the rule. Call the [`GET /core/sg-rules-protocols`](https://infrahub-api-doc.nexgencloud.com/#get-/core/sg-rules-protocols) endpoint to retrieve a list of permitted network protocols.

port_range_min.description: The minimum port number in the range of ports to be allowed by the firewall rule.

port_range_max.description: The maximum port number in the range of ports to be allowed by the firewall rule.

ethertype.description: The Ethernet type associated with the rule.

remote_ip_prefix.description: The IP address range that is allowed to access the specified port. Use "0.0.0.0/0" to allow any IP address.

flavor_restrictions.description: Flavor compatibility restrictions for this image

name.description: The name of the volume being created.

environment_name.description: The name of the [environment](https://docs.hyperstack.cloud/docs/api-reference/core-resources/environments/) within which the volume is being created.

description.description: A brief description or comment about the volume.

volume_type.description: Specifies the type of volume being created, which determines the storage technology it will use. Call the [List volume types](https://infrahub-api-doc.nexgencloud.com/#get-/core/volumes) endpoint to retrieve a list of available volume model types.

size.description: The size of the volume in GB. 1048576GB storage capacity per volume.

image_id.description: The ID of the operating system image that will be associated with the volume. By providing an `image_id` in the create volume request, you will create a bootable volume.

callback_url.description: A URL that can be attached to the volume you are creating. This `callback_url` will post any action events that occur to your volume to the provided URL.

redemption_count.description: Current redemption count for a General Voucher

max_redemption_count.description: Max redemption count for a General Voucher

mfa_enabled.description: Whether MFA is enabled for the user

name.description: The new name of the environment.

apiKey.description: Send it as api_key in header
apiKey.name: api_key
